paragraphs: Shoe care requires several brushes because each one does something the others would ruin. One applies, one buffs, one removes dirt, and using the polishing brush on mud is how a good pair of shoes gets scratched.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the brushes as static pieces. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 the set suits product and retail visualisation, e-commerce imagery, interior and wardrobe scenes, advertising, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

The shroud is famous partly because the image reads as a photographic negative, which is why almost nobody has seen it the way it actually appears on the cloth. Framed and displayed, it is an object argued over for centuries.
The model is extremely light at 2,070 polygons and 2,247 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, framed, and carries StemCell certification.
At $29 it suits religious and historical visualisation, museum and exhibition work, documentary graphics, film props, interior scenes and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.
Reposado means rested, and the rest is in oak for months rather than years. That is what separates it from the clear spirit and from the aged one, and the colour on the shelf is doing the explaining.
The model is light at 18,580 polygons and 18,588 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 7 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits beverage and packaging visualisation, label mockups, e-commerce and retail imagery, bar and interior scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2020.

Silicone bristles replaced nylon in kitchen brushes for a reason that has nothing to do with cleaning: they do not hold water, so they do not grow anything between uses. The performance is slightly worse and the hygiene is much better.
The model is very light at 14,416 polygons and 14,715 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits kitchen and product visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, interior scenes, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

Snow goggles are solving glare and wind at the same time, and the tint is chosen for the light rather than for style. A lens that works in bright sun is genuinely dangerous in flat light, which is why serious skiers carry two.
The model carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a generic build is offered separately.
At $29 it suits sports equipment and apparel visualisation, e-commerce imagery, character accessories, advertising, film costume and editorial illustration. On sale since 2015.

The stacking crate is one of the quiet infrastructures of food supply. It nests when empty, stacks when full, survives washing at temperatures that would destroy cardboard, and the same crate makes hundreds of journeys.
The model holds 52,144 polygons and 52,330 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 5 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries StemCell certification.
At $29 it suits logistics and food industry visualisation, market and warehouse scenes, packaging presentation, film set dressing, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2019.

The film can is a piece of packaging that became a symbol. Almost nothing is shot on film any more, and the flat metal tin still appears on posters, awards and signage wherever cinema needs to be indicated at a glance.

The model is light at 22,924 polygons and 23,019 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 13 maps, 12 at 4096x4096 and one at 1024x1024. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $29 it suits film and media visualisation, decor and signage work, period and studio scenes, advertising, museum material and editorial illustration. On sale since 2015.

Defensive sprays are regulated differently in almost every country, which is why the format varies so much: keyring, pen, canister, gel or foam. The packaging is designed around what is legal to carry where it is sold.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the sprays as static pieces. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $27 the set suits personal security and product visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, film and television props, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

Filters are the consumable that decides how long an engine lasts, and they are all the same shape for the same reason: the housing was designed around a spin on canister decades ago and nothing has displaced it.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the filters as static pieces. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $25 the set suits automotive parts visualisation, aftermarket and e-commerce imagery, technical documentation, workshop scenes, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

The upright bottle machine dispensed glass, not cans, and the mechanism inside was mechanical rather than electronic. Rusted and faded, it belongs to roadside archaeology as much as to advertising history.
The model is light at 46,193 polygons and 23,613 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs, in aged condition. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $24 it suits period and retro visualisation, film and television sets, roadside and diner scenes, advertising, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

The chasen is cut from a single piece of bamboo into dozens of tines, and it is a consumable: it wears out and is replaced. Nothing else whisks matcha properly, and every attempt to make one from another material has failed.
The model holds 30,824 polygons and 30,608 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, because the tines have to be real geometry. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $24 it suits food and beverage visualisation, product and e-commerce imagery, cultural and hospitality scenes, advertising, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

The concertina mat is the only sleeping pad that cannot be punctured, which is why it survives alongside inflatables that are lighter and more comfortable in every other respect. It also unfolds in about two seconds.

The model is very light at 7,192 polygons and 7,074 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in grey, and comes rigged so it can be posed folded or open. It is built to CheckMate specification, and native rigged builds for Cinema 4D and Maya are offered separately.
At $24 it suits camping and outdoor visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, character accessories, advertising, film props and game environments. On sale since 2025.

A house of cards holds itself up entirely by friction and balance, which is why it is such a durable metaphor. Nothing is fastened, every card depends on every other, and the whole thing fails completely rather than partially.
The model is very light at 8,100 polygons and 8,208 vertices, built in quads only with overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification.
At $24 it suits editorial and conceptual illustration, advertising and financial imagery, motion graphics, film props, game assets and interior scenes. On sale since 2026.

A cassette unit hides in the ceiling and blows in four directions at once, which is why it is used in offices and shops where nobody should be sitting in the draught. Only the grille is visible; the machine is above the tiles.
The model is very light at 9,576 polygons and 4,854 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $24 it suits architectural and building services visualisation, commercial interiors, equipment marketing, film sets, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.
